title: What does ChatGPT return about human values? Exploring value bias in ChatGPT using a descriptive value theory
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures how ChatGPT represents the 'Tradition' value from Schwartz's basic value theory. The 'Tradition' value is defined as the 'Preservation, respect and commitment to norms and customs of one's traditional culture or religion'. The study analyzes the frequency and fidelity with which this and other values are represented in the model's generated text.
findings: The 'Tradition' value, which explicitly includes religion in its definition, was one of the least frequently observed values in the text generated by ChatGPT. However, despite its low frequency, it demonstrated the best and most consistent discriminant performance, meaning it was clearly distinguishable from other values across different prompts.
